'''Heklu''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Riileb/Legends|Riileb]]<ref name="AE" /> in the [[Riileb system/Legends|Riileb system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The species' meat was considered a delicacy on many [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and transporting heklu was one of the only reasons [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] found that made visiting the creatures' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] worthwhile.<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The heklu were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth]] issue of the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|Star Wars roleplaying game]] series the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. The species was mentioned in an article titled "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]," written by [[Brian Smithson]].<ref name="AE" /> A reduced version of the article was reprinted in ''[[Alien Encounters]]'', a collection that included all "Alien Encounters" articles, compiled by [[Paul Sudlow]] in [[1998]].<ref name="AE Reprint">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
